title: CLI command (registries/cli/*.yaml) - DRAFT
description: A command a plugin adds to the hax CLI, exposed as `hax <plugin id> <command>` while the plugin is enabled. The CLI embeds the backend in-process, so it calls the plugin's operation directly with no network or credentials; the core CLI never names a plugin. A plugin may also declare a short top-level alias.

alias.description: Optional top-level shortcut, so `hax <alias>` runs `hax <plugin id> <command>`. Declared by the plugin, never written into the CLI. Refused if it matches a core command (cli-reserved.json) or another enabled plugin's alias; the namespaced form always works.

summary.description: One line for `hax <plugin id> --help`; translatable through the plugin's locale overlay.

param.description: Query parameter it fills, e.g. filter[type].

value.description: For boolean flags: the value sent when present.

items.description: Dot path to the array to print; omit for a single item.

line.description: Template per item for human output, e.g. '{{label}}: {{description}}'. --json always prints the raw response.
